summary: Resolve an occurrence id to its passage and document, so a reloaded view whose selection is an occurrence opens the passage.

o55012.note: The 1994 Hip-hop mark of §1.11; start/end are in the same base as the passage's start/end.

not_found.note: An occurrence of a run that was garbage-collected, or a mistyped id.

error.hint: Occurrences belong to a materialize run; search the expression again.
